— 200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully retrieved the ARM template for the
specified Azure Frictionless Assessment connector.
— 400
Returned if your request specified invalid input parameters, if your request was improperly formatted,
or if an error occurred while processing the request.
— 404 Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management could not find the specified connector.
— 429
Returned if you attempt to send too many requests in a specific period of time. For more information,
see Rate Limiting.
